title: Learn Grafana for Go Services
description: Build a working observability stack, write PromQL, create dashboards and alerts, instrument Go, and provision Grafana from files.

lessons.title: What Is Grafana?
lessons.instruction: Open Grafana from the lab panel and sign in with admin / admin. Verify the Grafana API and database are healthy.

lessons.title: The Observability Stack
lessons.instruction: Open the Go service, Prometheus, and Grafana links from the lab panel. Confirm every service and the go-lab Prometheus scrape target are healthy.

lessons.title: Install Grafana
lessons.instruction: In Grafana, open Administration → General → Stats and inspect version 13.2.0 and the database.

lessons.title: The Grafana UI
lessons.instruction: Choose Dashboards → New → New dashboard. Add any visualization titled Read Run UI Tour, then save the dashboard.

lessons.title: Organizations
lessons.instruction: Open Administration → General → Organizations and create Read Run Lab. Continue working in the default organization for shared course resources.

lessons.title: Data Sources
lessons.instruction: Open Connections → Data sources → Add new data source. Choose Prometheus, name it Read Run Prometheus, and save it.

lessons.title: Add Prometheus
lessons.instruction: Edit Read Run Prometheus. Set the server URL to http://prometheus:9090, keep Server access, enable Default, and save.

lessons.title: Test the Connection
lessons.instruction: Open Read Run Prometheus and click Save & test. Confirm Grafana can query the Prometheus API.

lessons.title: Scrape Targets
lessons.instruction: Open Prometheus, then Status → Target health. Confirm the go-lab job endpoint is UP.

lessons.title: Explore
lessons.instruction: Open Explore, select Read Run Prometheus, and run go_lab_requests_total. Choose Add to dashboard, add it to Read Run UI Tour, and save.

lessons.title: Metric Selectors
lessons.instruction: Enter go_lab_requests_total to return every live series for that metric.

lessons.title: Labels
lessons.instruction: Filter go_lab_requests_total with the exact label matcher job="go-lab".

lessons.title: Range Vectors
lessons.instruction: Select the last five minutes of samples using go_lab_requests_total[5m].

lessons.title: Rate
lessons.instruction: Convert the counter to a per-second rate with rate(go_lab_requests_total[5m]).

lessons.title: Aggregations
lessons.instruction: Return request rate per job using sum by (job) (rate(go_lab_requests_total[5m])).

lessons.title: First Dashboard
lessons.instruction: Choose Dashboards → New → New dashboard and save it as Read Run Go Service.

lessons.title: Panels
lessons.instruction: Edit Read Run Go Service. Add a time-series panel using Read Run Prometheus and rate(go_lab_requests_total[5m]), give it a useful title, apply, and save.

lessons.title: Time Ranges
lessons.instruction: Open Read Run Go Service, choose Last 6 hours in the time picker, then save and include the current time range.

lessons.title: Dashboard Variables
lessons.instruction: In Read Run Go Service, open Dashboard settings → Variables → Add variable. Name it job, choose Query, select Read Run Prometheus, use label_values(go_lab_requests_total, job), and save.

lessons.title: Dashboard JSON
lessons.instruction: Open Read Run Go Service → Dashboard settings → JSON model. Copy the model into the editor, retaining the title, panels, and job variable.

lessons.title: Alert Rules
lessons.instruction: Choose Alerting → Alert rules → New alert rule; name High Request Rate. Query Read Run Prometheus with rate(go_lab_requests_total[5m]), add threshold, select folder and evaluation group, then save.

lessons.title: Expressions
lessons.instruction: Edit High Request Rate. Add a Grafana Reduce expression between the Prometheus query and threshold, then save.

lessons.title: Contact Points
lessons.instruction: Open Alerting → Contact points. Add a Webhook contact point named Read Run Contact with URL http://metrics:8081/alerts, then save.

lessons.title: Notification Policies
lessons.instruction: Open Alerting → Notification policies. Route the default policy or a matching child policy to Read Run Contact, then save.

lessons.title: Silences
lessons.instruction: Open Alerting → Silences → Add silence. Match High Request Rate, include that name in the comment, choose a short duration, and submit.

lessons.title: Prometheus Text Format
lessons.instruction: Complete both Println calls to emit exactly # TYPE requests_total counter followed by requests_total 7.

lessons.title: Metrics Handler
lessons.instruction: Implement metrics to write requests_total 3 to the ResponseWriter in valid Prometheus format.

lessons.title: Counters
lessons.instruction: Increment requests once for each handled request, then print the final value 3.

lessons.title: Gauges
lessons.instruction: Start active at 2; print it, increment and print when a request begins, then decrement and print when it completes.

lessons.title: Histograms
lessons.instruction: Count observations less than or equal to 0.5, then print request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 2 in Prometheus format.

lessons.title: Provisioning
lessons.instruction: Set options.path to /var/lib/grafana/dashboards in the apiVersion 1 dashboard provider YAML. Keep Read Run Provider so Grafana loads Provider Check.
lessons.starter:
apiVersion: 1

providers:
  - name: Read Run Provider
    orgId: 1
    folder: Read Run Provisioned
    type: file
    disableDeletion: false
    updateIntervalSeconds: 10
    options:
      path: TODO

lessons.title: Folders and Permissions
lessons.instruction: Create dashboard folder Read Run Operations. Open folder permissions, add at least one explicit user, team, or role permission, then save.

lessons.title: Data Source Provisioning
lessons.instruction: Set the provisioned Prometheus data source URL to http://prometheus:9090. Keep name Provisioned Prometheus, UID provisioned-prometheus, and editable false.
lessons.starter:
apiVersion: 1

datasources:
  - name: Provisioned Prometheus
    uid: provisioned-prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: TODO
    isDefault: false
    editable: false

lessons.title: Dashboard Provisioning
lessons.instruction: Set UID to read-run-provisioned and title to Read Run Provisioned. Keep schemaVersion 39 and panels valid.

lessons.title: Backups
lessons.instruction: Export the complete Read Run Go Service dashboard JSON and paste its model here, retaining UID read-run-go, title, and panels.
